settings._comment: Registers the append-only evidence-file guard (validate-evidence-append-only.sh) into the committed .claude/settings.json, NOT settings.local.json, since a guard over a tracked, shared archival record is required functionality rather than personal MCP/permission preference (same test core's own merge_targets.settings _comment applies to the WezTerm lifecycle hooks) -- settings.local.json is gitignored in a consumer repo and invisible to verify-deploy.sh's registration gate besides. The registration MUST stay bare (no `2>/dev/null || echo '{}'` wrapper): that wrapper converts the hook's exit 2 into exit 0 and silently disables the block. The fragment's matcher string MUST remain byte-identical to core's own "Write|Edit" block (merge-sources/settings-hooks.json): deep_merge joins per EXACT-STRING matcher, so any other spelling creates a second, permanently undeletable registration block rather than joining the existing one (the merge is add-only). The same add-only property means a future rename of this hook script would leave a stale registration in already-synced repos -- there is no self-healing mechanism for a drifted command path.
